customers_say: Customers find this water purifier to be the best in the market with a premium appearance and user-friendly mobile app. The installation process is well-executed, and they appreciate its features, with one customer highlighting the information parameters of different parts. The taste is good, and customers find it easy to use. However, reliability and value for money receive mixed reviews, with some reporting it stops working after a few days and others expressing regret about their purchase.

reviews.author: Justin
reviews.title: Best one - out there
reviews.body: Amazing product and great installation experience. Clear explanation provided. I recommend this over all other non adaptive water purifiers. Saves water plus saves money.

reviews.author: Mohan
reviews.title: Worth the money
reviews.body: Overall, its a nice product and good for borewell and corporate waters. Had a nice experince with customer serivice. After delivery, the service person came quickly and installed the device without any hassle.

reviews.author: Harish
reviews.title: Good Product and Smooth Installation
reviews.body: Received my Automberg water purifier recently, and overall, I’m happy with the experience. The product was delivered safely and on time. The installation process was also smooth and hassle-free, with everything set up properly. So far, the product looks good and works well. Overall, a good experience with both the delivery and installation.

reviews.author: Jay
reviews.title: Good one
reviews.body: Been using this purifier for a couple of weeks now and overall experience is good. Water tastes clean and the purifier looks quite premium in the kitchen. Installation was also smooth. So far, no issues with the product. The adaptive mode was the main reason I went for this one. Water quality in my area keeps changing, so I didn't want RO running unnecessarily all the time. The purifier adjusts according to the incoming water, which is quite convenient. Good product overall. Build quality is genuinely good. It feels sturdy and the finishing is also nice.
